title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct differential equation for v(r).

title: Use of Green's Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of how to apply Green's function in the derivation.

title: Substitution of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly substitute U and k in the context of the problem.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should justify the use of the first Born approximation in their derivation.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should maintain mathematical consistency throughout the derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the final equation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that units are consistent throughout the derivation.
